title: Upgrade /login phone field to international phone input with autodetect, per-country validation, and luxury theming

requirements.summary: Replace /login phone <Input> with an international phone input (flag + country name + dial code selector + number input) with searchable dropdown and at least 20 popular countries.
acceptanceCriteria: In both Sign In and Sign Up tabs on /login, the phone step shows a country dropdown (flag + country name + dial code) and a number input side-by-side, responsive to small screens.
The country dropdown is searchable and allows changing the country manually.
At least 20 countries are available in the dropdown, including India (+91), United States (+1), United Kingdom (+44), and UAE (+971).

file_operations.description: Create a reusable InternationalPhoneInput wrapper component for /login that renders a left-side searchable country selector (flag + country name + dial code) and a right-side phone number input, designed to be used in both Sign In and Sign Up tabs. Use shadcn-ui primitives already present in the project (e.g., Button/Input/Label/Popover-like patterns) to compose UI without modifying frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a curated country list (>= 20 entries) containing ISO country code, country name, dial code, and flag display metadata for the dropdown (must include India +91, United States +1, United Kingdom +44, UAE +971).

Replace the existing plain phone number Input fields in both Sign In and Sign Up flows with the new InternationalPhoneInput component and wire its value into the existing /login OTP flow state. Use existing shadcn-ui components (Tabs/Card/Button/etc.) as-is; do not modify frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Auto-detect and pre-select the user’s country on /login load; default to India (+91) when detection fails or is unsupported.
acceptanceCriteria: On first load of /login, the country selector is pre-populated automatically without user input.
If auto-detection cannot determine a supported country, the selector defaults to India (+91).
The selected flag and dial code are visible immediately on render.

file_operations.description: Implement a browser-based country detection helper (e.g., Intl locale / navigator.language region hints) that maps to a supported country from the curated list and falls back to India (IN) when unknown/unsupported.

On /login initial render, call the locale-based detection utility to set the initial selected country for the InternationalPhoneInput; ensure fallback to India (+91) and that the flag/dial code render immediately without user interaction.

requirements.summary: Add per-country phone validation on blur and on Send OTP; block OTP sending when invalid; show inline error below the phone input group with required text and styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid numbers show an inline error directly below the phone input group (not only as a top-of-card alert).
Inline error uses pearl-blue text styling and a gold border treatment as specified, and uses the exact required sentence with the country name substituted.
Clicking 'Send OTP' does not proceed to the OTP step when the phone number is invalid for the selected country.
India selection validates as a 10-digit national number (with +91 country code applied in the stored/sent value).

file_operations.description: Add a robust phone parsing/validation dependency (e.g., libphonenumber-js) to support per-country validation and E.164 formatting entirely on the frontend.

Implement per-country phone validation utilities that (a) validate national number vs selected country rules and (b) produce an E.164 formatted number with leading '+'. Ensure India validates as a 10-digit national number.

Wire blur-triggered validation behavior: when the phone number input loses focus, validate against the selected country and surface an inline error state to the parent. Inline error rendering must appear directly below the phone input group and read exactly: "Please enter a valid [country] mobile number" with [country] from the current selection. Use shadcn-ui primitives as needed without modifying frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update Send OTP click handling to run the same per-country validation prior to generating OTP; prevent transition to the OTP step and display the inline error when invalid. Keep existing lockout/attempt logic intact.

requirements.summary: Match the new phone input group styling to the existing dark luxury theme with pearl-blue accents and gold hover/glow; ensure responsive layout and preserve Send OTP button pulse/glow behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Country dropdown and phone input visually match the app’s dark luxury theme and do not introduce mismatched light styles.
Dropdown and interactive states show gold hover/glow effects; pearl-blue is used for primary accents.
Send OTP button continues to use the continuous pulse/glow styling already used on the page.
Mobile layout stacks or compresses gracefully with no clipping/overlap; the overall control remains full-width.

file_operations.description: Apply layout and className adjustments around the new phone input group so it is fully responsive (full-width on mobile, no overflow) and so the existing Send OTP button retains its current gold-pulse-glow behavior.

Implement dark-luxury themed styling for the dropdown + input: dark backgrounds, pearl-blue accent focus states, and gold hover/glow states on the dropdown trigger/list items. Use existing Tailwind tokens (primary/accent) and avoid introducing light default styles. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add small, globally-scoped utility classes (or refinements) needed for the phone input group’s gold hover/glow and inline validation treatment (pearl-blue text + gold border), ensuring consistency with existing luxury theme tokens and reduced-motion behavior.

requirements.summary: Preserve existing OTP flow (send → simulated OTP → verify → /dashboard, attempts/lockout) while storing/sending the phone number in E.164 format with the selected dial code.
acceptanceCriteria: The OTP step UI and verification logic continue to function as before (including attempt counting and 10-minute lockout).
The OTP session stores the full international phone number including '+' and the selected country dial code.
Changing country + number and resending OTP still transitions correctly to the OTP step when valid.

file_operations.description: Refactor /login state so OTP generation/verification still behaves identically, but the stored session phone number is the validated E.164 value (leading '+', includes selected dial code). Ensure resend with changed country/number still works and continues to respect lockout/attempt handling.

Confirm OTPSession creation continues to persist the phoneNumber string as provided by /login; update any naming/assumptions in comments/types if needed so it is explicitly treated as an international E.164-style value.

requirements.summary: Append an internal QA checklist for this change to frontend/RELEASE_NOTES.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Release notes include a short checklist covering the specified confirmations for manual verification.

file_operations.description: Append a brief internal QA checklist covering: auto-detection with India fallback, dropdown shows flags/names/codes + searchable manual selection, per-country validation, no UI/hover/animation regressions (including Send OTP gold pulse/glow), and OTP flow end-to-end still works.
